name: Kanmi Dokoro
description: Kanmi Dokoro — a wagashi tea house theme with a formal top bar (tea house name, a one-row menu and a Reserve a window seat button). Kikyo bellflower purple (#5654A2) is the main colour: the hero half, every page head, the menu panel and the calendar band are kikyo fields with a bellflower watercolour multiplied in, set in white. The site is built as split screens: the hero sets the kikyo field beside a paper wall where the garden is framed as an open window, and a cut-out bellflower sweet breaks out of the window frame across the seam; a cut-out matcha bowl breaks over the calendar band and the sweet sits across the seam of every page head. Every picture is a soft watercolour illustration. Hina Mincho for display, Outfit for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-27 (split-screen, framed-window hero, top-bar nav, full-illustration, watercolour, kikyo #5654A2, Hina Mincho + Outfit). A formal top bar (tea house name, tagline, one-row menu, Reserve a window seat button; overlay menu on phones). Every picture is a full watercolour illustration. Break-frame: the cut-out bellflower sweet (transparent WebP) breaks out of the framed garden window, across the split-screen seam into the kikyo field and over the hero bottom edge; the cut-out matcha bowl breaks over the calendar band's top edge; the sweet sits across the seam of every split page head. Traditional Chinese headings use a bundled Noto Serif TC subset (mincho, the closest to Hina Mincho).

summary.zh-TW: 桔梗紫的和菓子茶屋：左右分割畫面，庭園框在窗裡，去背和菓子破框越過分界；水彩插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A kikyo-purple wagashi tea house: split screens, the garden framed as a window and a cut-out sweet breaking out of it.
summary.ja: 桔梗色の和菓子の茶屋。左右に分かれた画面、窓に切り取った庭、枠を破って飛び出す切り抜きの菓子。水彩画と五か国語のサンプル付き。
summary.fr: Un salon de thé wagashi violet campanule : écrans partagés, jardin encadré en fenêtre, douceur détourée qui en sort.
summary.de: Ein glockenblumenlila Wagashi-Teehaus: geteilte Seiten, der Garten als Fenster gerahmt, eine freigestellte Süßigkeit bricht heraus.
